summary: Join our comprehensive training course on Fraud Detection and Financial Crime Analytics. Equip yourself with essential tools to tackle financial crime.
lede: Financial crime analytics helps risk, audit, compliance, finance and data professionals identify suspicious activity and investigate it with evidence. Learners assess fraud risks, prepare and connect transaction data, build exception rules and anomaly checks, and prioritize alerts without treating unusual patterns as proof. They also practice documenting cases, presenting findings, and recommending control improvements.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who regularly manage risk, controls, investigations, or analytics.
audience: AML/CFT and financial crime compliance staff
Fraud investigators and case management teams
modules: Data Preparation for Fraud Analytics Without Overcomplication
Red Flags and Exception Reporting That Actually Works
Payroll, Benefits, and HR Fraud Analytics
Financial Crime Controls and AML/Transaction Monitoring Basics
Biases and Pitfalls in Fraud Detection
prerequisites: Participants should have a basic understanding of organizational processes and elementary data handling skills. Prior exposure to risk management or compliance functions is beneficial but not necessary.
topics: Statistics & data analysis (SPSS, Stata, R, Python)
